scope: Independent manual reading of all six delivered answers, cited passages, task plans/outcomes and execution records against the unchanged 18 declared checks. No new model calls or criteria changes.

criteria_reviews.check: Explains the three roles using cited documentation.
criteria_reviews.reason: Explains Ops/Calls tracing, dataset-and-scorer evaluations, and Signals with cited inputs, execution triggers and outputs; all nine planned facets are present.

criteria_reviews.check: Signals are described as scoring completed turns.
criteria_reviews.reason: Explicitly describes completed-turn scoring, root-span completion and weave.genai.turn_ended. The lifecycle is cited from the remote-scorer page with a scope caveat; remote HTTP details are not generalized.

criteria_reviews.check: Does not promise monitoring will prevent or prove errors.
criteria_reviews.reason: Makes no promise that monitoring prevents errors, blocks delivery or proves safety.
Uses the same conversation and exact preceding user/assistant messages, verified against the overview capture.

criteria_reviews.check: Separates after-completion monitoring from an in-agent release check.
criteria_reviews.reason: Separates completed-turn scoring from inline guardrails that affect application control flow; S14 and S15 including page_context support the distinction.

criteria_reviews.check: Does not claim a Signal guarantees safety.
criteria_reviews.reason: Does not claim a Signal guarantees safety; its concrete blocking recommendation is an application guardrail.

criteria_reviews.check: Gives current conversation/turn and model/tool instrumentation guidance.
criteria_reviews.reason: Provides initialization, stable conversation ID, per-turn roots and model/tool instrumentation supported by six cited passages.

criteria_reviews.check: Separates trace grouping from actual conversation history; any tool-result example preserves preceding assistant tool calls.
criteria_reviews.reason: Explicitly separates span grouping from history. Exact offline fake execution preserves assistant history over two turns. Tool instrumentation is comments, so no tool-result example or protocol path is claimed tested.

criteria_reviews.check: Does not claim unexecuted Weave integrations were executed.
criteria_reviews.reason: Calls the code a minimal sketch and identifies call_llm as a placeholder; it makes no claim that the integration was executed.

criteria_reviews.check: Explains dataset fields, prediction and scorer mapping.
criteria_reviews.reason: Maps task_id/user_request/success_criteria to agent execution, reply/transcript, judge verdict and logged task-completion score.

criteria_reviews.check: Includes a usable documented evaluation invocation.
criteria_reviews.reason: Uses the documented EvaluationLogger/log_prediction/log_score/log_summary invocation. Helper implementations and imports remain application setup; this is a guided snippet, not a standalone runnable program.

criteria_reviews.check: Explains a judge rubric without treating its verdict as certain.
criteria_reviews.reason: Explains a judge rubric over request, success criteria and transcript, returning passed/reason without claiming certainty. It does not explicitly discuss judge fallibility; that remains a limitation rather than an added criterion.

criteria_reviews.check: Does not present the invented API as real.
criteria_reviews.reason: Declines the invented API signature and limits the absence claim to the stored documentation snapshot searched.
Rejects the zero-hallucination guarantee and distinguishes measurement from prevention.

criteria_reviews.check: Offers relevant documented alternatives with source citations.
criteria_reviews.reason: Offers cited HallucinationFreeScorer, inline guardrail and monitoring alternatives, and carefully discloses that the scorer/guardrail pairing was not read as an example.

criteria_reviews.check: Actually invokes run_python and records successful execution.
criteria_reviews.reason: Saved actions contain one successful run_python invocation with exit_code=0 and receipt C1.

criteria_reviews.check: Calculates 2/4 = 0.5 and cites the execution receipt.
criteria_reviews.reason: Correctly reports [True, False, True, False] and 2/4=0.5 with C1.

criteria_reviews.check: Connects deterministic scoring to documented Evaluation behavior without claiming a live Weave integration test.
criteria_reviews.reason: Connects per-row output/label matching and boolean summarization to documented Evaluation behavior; explicitly labels the Weave sketch untested and its model a placeholder.

source_review: All retained cited passages were manually read, including supplied page_context. No material retained-answer source-authority failure was found. Shared lifecycle/API semantics on integration or remote-scorer pages were assessed by their actual text, without a blanket page-domain ban. All 29 cited documentation records match frozen corpus passages and metadata.

observed_repair_mechanism.overview: First draft lacked the Signal execution trigger and misattributed Agent Lens text. The verifier requested the missing premise; search/read obtained S14; the revised second submission delivered all nine facets and passed.
observed_repair_mechanism.budget: Overview admitted eighteen research dispatches and two answer submissions. It completed without terminal partial recovery or full-answer recheck.
observed_repair_mechanism.causal_limit: One stochastic run on reused tasks does not isolate the effect of each change or establish general reliability. The full-answer recheck path was not exercised in any of these six answers.

limitations: Six reused development questions are not held-out evidence or a general reliability/latency estimate.
Responses remain substantial: 304–413 whitespace words and 30.61–120.99 seconds.

The tracing sketch was executed only with offline fake weave/call_llm. Tool instrumentation is commented scaffolding; no tool-result protocol, installed SDK, exporter or provider integration was tested.
The evaluation answer uses a documented helper-based invocation and does not explicitly discuss judge fallibility. Helper definitions, imports and provider setup remain user work.

The invented-API answer preserves a source example with output mapped to other_col despite no such dataset field in the snippet. It was not executed; source faithfulness is not proof of SDK example correctness.
The follow-up gives a cautious LLM-judge-setup scope disclaimer despite inheriting custom-signal documentation from the overview. It does not alter the completed-turn versus inline-check distinction.
No partial recovery or full-answer recheck occurred; this packet cannot establish those paths succeed live.
Browser observations belong to browser.json; this manual review does not claim a new browser replay.
Costs are returned-usage estimates for UI agent work and exclude online Signal worker charges.
